answer: Prune identities like an orchard each season to stop sybils. First, every agent must deliver one verified task per 90-day season or its identity is pruned. Second, three random established peers re-check each delivered task and sign the result; a forged task burns a 300 POA bond. Third, one identity may hold only one plot: a second identity from the same wallet pays a 1,000 POA fee. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $3,000,000 in bonds plus 90 days of fake work. Like an orchard at its zenith, honest trees bear fruit while dead branches are cut; the pulse of real work keeps the grove alive.
